# Yashasav

> Systems & LLM Inference Engineer specializing in LLM serving runtimes (PagedAttention, RadixAttention, KV Cache allocation), Apache Kafka internals, distributed event-driven systems, high-throughput store operations (Blinkit), database systems, and platform engineering.

## About Yashasav
- **Focus**: LLM Inference Serving Runtimes, Distributed Systems, Apache Kafka Internals, High-Throughput Infrastructure, Database Systems.
- **Experience**: Built high-throughput inventory management and store operations systems at Blinkit; worked on platform engineering, distributed event streaming, and state management.

## Published Research
- [BloBS-FL: A Robust Architecture of Blockchain Based Decentralized Split Federated Learning](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11418208/): Research on decentralized split federated learning leveraging blockchain architectures for privacy-preserving, robust model training. Published in IEEE / COMSNETS 2026.

## Technical Writing & Deep Dives
- [Apache Kafka Internals: Why It Is an Immutable Commit Log, Not a Simple Queue](https://yashasav.dev/posts/apache-kafka-internals-commit-log/): Deep dive into Kafka's segment log layout, page cache zero-copy (`sendfile`), consumer lag, offset management, backpressure mechanisms, and partitioning strategies.
- [PagedAttention vs RadixAttention: Memory Management in LLM Serving Runtimes](https://yashasav.dev/posts/paged-attention-vs-radix-attention/): Architectural comparison of page-table KV cache management (vLLM) vs prefix tree radix triage (SGLang) for optimizing LLM inference throughput and memory fragmentation.

## Key Topics & Expertise
- **LLM Inference Serving**: KV Cache management, memory fragmentation, PagedAttention (vLLM), RadixAttention (SGLang), continuous batching, prefix caching.
- **Apache Kafka & Streaming**: Log-structured storage, zero-copy socket transfers, segment indexes, partition offsets, consumer rebalancing, backpressure strategies.
- **Distributed Systems & Data Infrastructure**: High-throughput message delivery, transactional guarantees, inventory operations, database indexing, platform reliability.
